subject: Purchase metadata, debit memo acceptance, and billing rhythm alignment
messages:
From: Monica Alvarez <monica.alvarez@medisys.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medisys AP <ap@medisys.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing format + debit memo question for upcoming renewal

Hi Sergio,

We’re finalizing internal routing for the renewal and have two procurement asks before we can sign:

1) Invoice header fields: our ERP requires a purchase reference (PurchaseRef), BU code, and a consolidated line for the subscription SKU. If those aren’t present we need to route invoices back to vendors which delays payment.
2) Debit memos: our AP team occasionally issues debit memos to reconcile usage. We need confirmation that Redwood will accept and net debit memos against future invoices (not via separate credit notes).
3) Billing rhythm: preferred cadence is fortnightly statements consolidated to a single monthly remittance. If fortnightly doesn’t work, weekly statements with a monthly payment run is acceptable.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can include the PurchaseRef and BU fields on the invoice CSV we receive, agree to net debit memos against invoices, and support the fortnightly->monthly remittance pattern?

Thanks,
Monica
Procurement Manager
Medisys Health

---
Attachment: sample_invoice-medisys.csv (csv)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Alvarez <monica.alvarez@medisys.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing format + debit memo question for upcoming renewal

Hi Monica — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and an ask for a small amendment: 

1) Invoice fields: Yes, we can emit PurchaseRef and BU code in the invoice CSV and include a consolidated subscription line. We’ll need your ERP field names to map correctly (we can map PurchaseRef -> PurchaseRef, BU -> BUCode, and add a PurchaseLine column).

2) Debit memos: We’re generally able to net debit memos against future invoices, provided the memos include a reference to the original invoice or PurchaseRef and are issued within 90 days of the invoice. If Medisys needs a different window we can escalate.

3) Billing rhythm: We can generate fortnightly statement buckets and a single monthly remittance file. Finance will need the fortnightly statement dates in advance to reconcile cache/cutoffs.

Ask: because this changes our billing flow, can Medisys sign a one‑page SOW amendment to add the PurchaseRef mapping and the debit memo netting window? I’ll loop in Vanessa for finance approval and Grace for the SOW.

I’ll also attach a draft amendment and a sample CSV to show the header layout.

— Sergio
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: SOW_Amendment_Medisys.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: sample_invoice-medisys.csv (csv)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Alvarez <monica.alvarez@medisys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Medisys AP <ap@medisys.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing format + debit memo question for upcoming renewal

Monica / team — looping in finance and sales ops. Summary from our side and constraints: 

- We can embed custom fields (PurchaseRef, BUCode, PurchaseLine) in the invoice CSV and in the PDF header for the majority of accounts. For integrations that hit our automated billing pipeline we’ll need the exact column names you expect; our billing export is configurable but not freeform.
- Debit memo netting: finance is comfortable netting debit memos against future invoices as long as the memo references PurchaseRef and is limited to a 60‑day window after the invoice date for Medisys (we can extend to 90 days for enterprise contracts on approval).
- Billing cadence: fortnightly statements aggregated to one monthly remittance is operationally OK but requires a statement schedule to be provided to Redwood 10 business days before the first cycle so our ERPs can preconfigure cutoffs.

Operational asks: 1) Please confirm the exact CSV column names, 2) confirm Medisys will sign the SOW amendment, and 3) confirm AP will accept netting with a 60‑day window (or request the 90‑day exception via this thread).

If the 60‑day window is a blocker we can request approval from Finance leadership but that will take 2–3 business days.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Alvarez <monica.alvarez@medisys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medisys AP <ap@medisys.com>, Katherine Leung <katherine.leung@medisys.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 07:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing format + debit memo question for upcoming renewal

Thanks Vanessa. AP confirms they can include PurchaseRef in memo references and can operate on a 60‑day window as long as we log memos with an originating invoice number. We do have two additional asks: 

• Our tax team requires TaxID on the invoice header (EIN).
• For any debit memos > $10k we need a short supporting note (reason + contact) attached to the memo.

We’ll sign the SOW amendment and can provide the exact CSV column names by end of day Thursday. Also attaching our AP intake form for your billing team so they can map fields.

Regards,
Monica

---
Attachment: Medisys_AP_Intake_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Alvarez <monica.alvarez@medisys.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing format + debit memo question for upcoming renewal

Monica — appreciate the quick confirmation. Two commercial points to close on our side:

1) Commitment ladder: if Medisys agrees to a 12‑month committed spend tier we can extend the 60‑day debit memo window to 90 days and provide a 6% commit discount across the subscription lines.
2) Early invoice exemption: for very large debit memos (> $50k) we’d prefer to process as credit notes to avoid cashflow timing issues; we can add that carve‑out into the SOW amendment.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll update the discount_schedule_v2.xlsx and the SOW draft.

— Ben
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: discount_schedule_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Monica Alvarez <monica.alvarez@medisys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Medisys AP <ap@medisys.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing format + debit memo question for upcoming renewal

Thanks everyone — this is good progress. Confirming:

• Medisys will sign the SOW amendment to add PurchaseRef, BUCode, PurchaseLine, TaxID, and the debit memo handling rules.
• AP accepts 60‑day netting; Medisys procurement will commit to a 12‑month spend ladder if Redwood can extend the netting window to 90 days and apply the 6% commit discount Ben proposed. That’s our preferred commercial path.

Next steps: Sergio — please route the updated SOW + discount schedule for signature and add a DocuSign link. AP will validate the sample CSV once the column names are live.

Best,
Monica
Procurement Manager
Medisys Health
